description: The Built Environment Carbon Database (BECD) is a UK industry database of carbon assessments of built assets and construction products, developed by a partnership of construction sector bodies to become the main source for carbon estimating and benchmarking. The site read on 2026-09-28 says version 2.0.94 is live at carbon.becd.co.uk with a new interface, compliance with the RICS Professional Standard on Whole Life Carbon Assessment (2023) as well as the 2017 standard, a simplified input and export form aligned to EN 15978, downloadable projects grouped by assessment format, and a product section cleaned and extended with the Inventory of Carbon and Energy (ICE) version 4. It collects product data and entity-level project data from contributors and exchanges them with other databases and software. Coverage is the United Kingdom. Access is free after registration under a user agreement, which was not read, so reuse terms are unknown. Caveats: project entries are self-reported by contributors and vary in completeness. It supports embodied carbon benchmarks in capacity planning and appraisal of buildings and infrastructure. Related record: data-ramboll-co2mpare-building-carbon-database is a comparable building carbon database.
